name: Franklin X-40 Outdoor 12-Pack
description: A bulk 12-pack of Franklin's official outdoor tournament ball, the X-40. Built with a durable one-piece polymer shell designed to hold up on asphalt and concrete courts without cracking, with a consistent bounce profile approved for USA Pickleball sanctioned play.
care_instructions: Rinse off dirt and debris with water after play on abrasive surfaces; let air dry before storing. Keep out of prolonged direct sunlight to prevent UV discoloration and brittleness.
